title: Ya and Todavía No with Food and Traditions

sections.content: You know *ya* and *todavía no* from Unit 2. Here you combine them with food, drinks, dishes and traditions to say what is ready and what is still missing: *Ya he preparado el plato, pero todavía no he comprado la bebida*.

items.english: I have already prepared the dish.

items.spanish: Todavía no he comprado la bebida.
items.english: I have not bought the drink yet.
We have already prepared the food.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos preparado la bebida.
items.english: We have not prepared the drink yet.

rows: todavía no + what is still to do
Todavía no he comprado la bebida.

sections.content: Link the two markers with *pero* to show partial progress in a single breath: *Ya he preparado el plato, pero todavía no he comprado la bebida* — one clause done, one still pending.
